lines.text: Moses says to return a brother's straying ox or lost cloak, and to help lift his fallen donkey.
Moses says to let the mother bird go and to build a railing around a new roof.
When a husband falsely accuses his wife, her father and mother bring proof to the elders, who fine him fifty shekels.
A man found with another man's wife, and both must die; in the open country, only the man dies for overpowering a betrothed woman.
A man who seizes an unpledged virgin pays her father fifty shekels, and a man must not marry his uncle's wife.
